title: Give me that old time religion

lines.text: Give me that old time religion (3)
Give me that old time religion (3)
It was good for Paul and Silas (3)

It was good for our fathers (3)
It was good for the prophets (3)
It will take us all to heaven (3)
It will save us from the devil (3)
Give us that old time religion (2)
